intro: Lord Cobrahn is one of the four leaders of the corrupted Druids of the Fang lurking deep within the Wailing Caverns. Once a night elf druid of Naralex's noble order, which hoped to heal the Barrens, he succumbed to the nightmare infecting the cavern springs. Taking a lethal serpent guise, Cobrahn now commands broods of deviate serpents and defends the twisted labyrinth.

p: Before his fall, Cobrahn was one of the noble druids who followed Naralex. When Naralex ventured into the Wailing Caverns beneath the Barrens hoping to tap their underground springs and restore lush life to the arid wastes, Cobrahn accompanied him. However, when Naralex's Emerald Dream communion decayed into a twisting nightmare, Cobrahn's mind shattered alongside his brothers.

Rather than channeling the traditional totemic beasts of Cenarion tradition, the nightmare warped Cobrahn's shapeshifting into something predatory and reptilian. He now commands a deadly serpentine form that he unleashes in battle. Flanked by venomous deviate pythons and bearing a vicious clawed right hand, he oversees his section of the grottos, violently purging anyone seeking to break the nightmare's hold on the caverns.
